by: sanctions-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: The NZBN register's entity detail for one limited partnership (NZ or overseas), as the interface answered one call (JSON)

landmarks: a JSON object with a 13-digit nzbn
entityTypeCode Y (Limited Partnership (NZ)) or Z (Limited Partnership (Overseas))

roles: a list; each role has roleType (Partner for a general partner; Person Authorised For Service for an overseas partnership's agent), roleStatus Active or Inactive, startDate, endDate, uniqueIdentifier, rolePerson {title, firstName, middleNames, lastName} or roleEntity {entityName, nzbn}, roleAddress
addresses.addressList: a list with addressType REGISTERED, POSTAL, SERVICE, startDate, endDate

signals_note: GET https://api.business.govt.nz/gateway/nzbn/v5/entities/{nzbn} with our own subscription key, through the fetch gate, one call at a time; landed verbatim by hash. Stamps are New Zealand local (2008-05-02T00:00:00.000+1200): the day is the first ten characters. An answer not of this shape is set aside whole.
notes: Probed 21 October 2026 on three partnerships (a new NZ one, an old NZ one, an overseas one): every role's startDate and endDate was null, so a general partner's dates are not stated by the interface; Inactive marks a past partner. Limited partners are not in the answer and are not public (Limited Partnerships Act 2008). E-mail, phone and website stay in the document and are never read.
applies_to: every registered limited partnership in the Companies Office's monthly file (pub.companies), from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the shape; set the answer aside whole if it is not.

One partnership row: nzbn, sourceRegisterUniqueIdentifier, entityName (NULL where privacySettings.namePrivateInformation), kind from entityTypeCode, status, registrationDate, countryOfOrigin, the current REGISTERED address (no endDate) and its startDate.

One partner row per role with roleType Partner: the person's names or the body's name and NZBN, Active as current, the role's own dates where stated; a name withheld by the register is suppressed. A role of any other type is counted, not read.
Every roleAddress to the private twin only.
Of several answers for one partnership, the newest asked is read; the older are superseded, counted in the ledger.
gates: Every role of every answer read is a partner row, an other-role count or a catch-log line.
No address but a partnership's registered office is a published column.
Every frame partnership is answered or set aside (check.py).
